_comment: PHASE 2 (private until after the election). Round-2 live projection parameters; see PREREGISTRATION_ROUND2_PROJECTION.md. Frozen when protocol_frozen is true.

projection._min_ufs_source: owner's representativeness rule (FINDINGS P7, P11): at least 24 of the 27 UFs with >= 1% of their electorate counted; abroad is modelled but is not a UF
projection._half_width_source: max |error| of the 2-model mean over checkpoints 2-50% in two backtests (2022 r1->r2 and 2022 r1->2026 r1) was 0.625 pp, rounded up to 0.7 (FINDINGS P5). An envelope of 12 observed errors, not a probabilistic guarantee.
